description_en: Purges the logon credentials (password or SSH private key) of a specified host account
description_zh: 清除指定主机账户登录凭据（密码或SSH私钥）
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost reset-host-account-credential --instance-id bastionhost-cn-rp640dg0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-account-id 1 --credential-type Password --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetHostAccountCredential

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance to which the host account whose logon credentials you want to purge belongs.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要清除登录凭据的主机账户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance to which the host account whose logon credentials you want to purge belongs.
For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要清除登录凭据的主机账户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host account whose logon credentials you want to purge.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要清除登录凭据的主机账户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_account_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the logon credential to purge. Valid values:
Password: password
PrivateKey: SSH private key
parameters.help_zh:
指定要清除的登录凭据类型。取值：
Password：密码
PrivateKey：SSH私钥
parameters.name: credential_type

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
